change: Exclude committed cache mappings from transparent huge pages before writable population and HIP registration.

regression_test.baseline: New test fails on unchanged main: MADV_COLLAPSE succeeds on the registered mapping (return 0, errno 0).
regression_test.candidate: Complete backing/transfer test passes. All pages are resident and zero-filled; collapse rejects with EINVAL; GPU writes, host reads and final ledger release pass.
regression_test.format: Shared formatter passes all 571 C++ files.

standard_http.workload: Canonical d0 pp2048/tg128, C1, uninstrumented production
standard_http.qualification: No sustained prefill speedup is claimed from one sample. Corresponding output and draft counts match.

archive_replays.settings: Exact 65,665-input/256-output request, C1, MTP-7, cache bypass, 8 GiB backing, 60/30-second pauses, 9 GiB held host memory. Identical HIP/KFD instrumentation.
archive_replays.qualification: Diagnostic timings, not uninstrumented speed claims. Initial snapshot flag remains retained even though it did not recur above the gate in reverse order.

functional.settings: long-context and cache only; C2, context 16384, 8 GiB RAM/disk cache, qwen38 sampling, no vision.
functional.gate: Every request/phase: slowdown greater than 5% AND 3 ms. Original flags are not erased or relabeled as passes.
functional.qualification: Not a clean global timing gate. Balanced follow-up leaves one queue flag and one decode flag (also reported per token). Original snapshot measurements overlap unchanged-main variation. The reverse decode flag accompanies shorter snapshot time and unchanged request wall time. All raw flags remain unqualified.

allocation_diagnostic.scope: 951058432-byte allocations and 64 MiB GPU copies; idle loaded production model; ABBA four times. Diagnostic only, no end-to-end speed claim.

copy_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic. Copy submission span is not a GPU event duration; model-worker span includes intervening inference. Do not add overlapping timings.

pi.settings: C2, context 32768, MTP-7, thinking low; two passes of edit and bugfix in one retained conversation.
pi.inspection: All 13 tool results inspected. Two deliberate failing Node tests precede successful repairs; test files are unchanged and independent assertions pass. No protocol tag leakage, repeated-action loop or HTTP error. All 16 requests after the first reuse cached prefixes.

investigation.reporter_runtime_thp_policy: Not recorded; the published default does not prove the historical setting.

exact_container_code_audit.container_configuration: Only version/revision labels differ; environment, entrypoint and command match.
exact_container_code_audit.conclusion: Every extracted kernel function and its full metadata matches the corresponding historical local build. No GPU compiler/codegen mismatch exists between the measured local boundaries and these exact two images.

investigation.limits: Prevents huge-page allocation/promotion of cache backing. Does not prevent all page migration or all KFD evictions. The historical hundreds-of-ms decode slowdown is not reproduced by native commit controls. #598's huihui/C2 agentic harness is unavailable; this PR does not close it.
